subject: maths
question:
Given below are some of the measures of the sides and angles of five triangles. Which of the triangles given in the options is NOT congruent to ΔABC?

In ΔABC, m(overline{AB}) = 3.6 cm, m(overline{BC}) = 5 cm, m(overline{CA}) = 4 cm, m(∠B) = 52.4°, m(∠C) = 45.5° 

In ΔDEF, m(overline{DE}) = 4 cm, m(overline{EF}) = 5 cm, m(overline{FD}) = 3.6 cm

In ΔGHI, m(overline{HI}) = 5 cm, m(∠H) = 52.4°, m(∠I) = 45.5° 

In ΔJKL, m(overline{JK}) = 3.6 cm, m(overline{LJ}) = 4 cm, m(∠J) = 52.4° 

In ΔMNO, m(overline{MN}) = 3.6 cm, m(overline{NO}) = 5 cm, m(∠N) = 52.4°
solution:
**GIVEN:**

A triangle ABC 

AB = 3.6 cm, BC = 5 cm, CA = 4 cm 

angle B = 52.4^circ ,angle C = 45.5^circ

**CONCEPT USED:**

Two triangles are congruent if the corresponding sides are equal and the corresponding angles are equal.

**CALCULATION:**

In triangle ABC,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8891eddd5e325cff0afca7e44eab09672896650fd1ecfe029eb67c2d4ba59e9e.png] 

AB = 3.6 cm

BC = 5 cm 

AC = 4 cm

angle B = 52.4^circ angle C = 45.5 ^circ angle A = 82.5^circ

Now, considering triangle DEF, we have 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/940e8c2b53baef28b359e954604e967240f35d501fd57b30571196ed6c7989c7.png] 

 DE = 4 cm , EF = 5 cm , DF = 3.6cm 

⇒ Since, all the corresponding sides are equal. Hence, triangle DEF is congruent to triangle ABC by SSS ( Side -Side -Side)

Now, considering triangle GHI we have

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6f404c473f947a4a1c6b76083c78c4d40a2a44c5d530f256a36102cdf42ceb9.png] 

 Now, here we have HI = 5cm , angle H = 52.4^circ , angle I = 45.5^circ 

Since, two angles and one side included between them of triangle GHI is equivalent to the two angles and one side included of the triangle ABC 

Hence, triangle GHI is congruent to triangle ABC by ASA( Angle- Side - Angle)

Now, considering JKL, we have,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45bc1cbcfd3f20f6fac4934e41607b6aade6e484932b7026980a6ed02d394c02.png] 

Now, here we have JK= 3.6 cm, JL = 4 cm angle J = 52.4^circ Since, angle included between the two sides of triangle JKL is not equal to the angle included between the two sides of triangle ABC Hence, triangle JKL does not follow the property of SAS (Side - Angle - Side ) So, JKL is not congruent to ABC
